subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers keep this stale external PR as the candidate for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41064, or replace it with a current-main repair?
rationale: The bug is still meaningful, but the submitted branch is dirty against current main, lacks real proof, and conflicts with current active-run/protocol/shutdown contracts, so automation should not choose the ownership path alone.

options.title: Adopt or rewrite on current main
options.body: Create or push a current-main repair that preserves the useful behavior while fixing the filtered active-run, protocol-package, restart-drain, fallback, and deterministic-selection blockers.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: Keep this PR open as the candidate only if the contributor can refresh it onto current main and attach redacted live Dashboard proof.

options.title: Pause until replacement lands
options.body: Do not merge this branch; close it only after a viable replacement PR owns the linked issue or maintainers decide not to pursue the behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt or rewrite on current main
recommendation.body: Create or push a current-main repair that preserves the useful behavior while fixing the filtered active-run, protocol-package, restart-drain, fallback, and deterministic-selection blockers.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame points to recent work on the active-run and restart-close contracts that the PR must align with.
